SPAN AND SUPPORT LOAD TABLES
Source: Bechtel 3DG-P41B-00002-001, Appendix 1 (SAMPLE TABLES — project-specific values may differ)

---

COMMON LIMITATIONS FOR ALL TABLES:
1. Pipe content specific weight up to 1.25: span reduction factor = 0.90 (except Sch 10/20 with pipe > 10 in)
2. Concentrated weights (valves, risers, components): locate as close to support as possible; add 100% of concentrated weight to adjacent support
3. Pipe with horizontal elbow: reduce 25% of listed span (factor = 0.75)

SC-I/II SPECIFIC:
4. Vertical design load = weight load + 0.72 × weight load = 1.72 × weight load
5. Lateral seismic loads based on 1.14g (Fp = 1.14g, vertical = 2/3 Fp = 0.72g)

SC-III SPECIFIC:
4. Vertical design load = weight load + 0.96 × weight load = 1.96 × weight load
5. Lateral seismic loads based on 1.44g (Fp per UBC formula 32.1, vertical = 2/3 Fp = 0.96g)
